selection.en: Two published Helsinki course editions directly support geometry, CRS, spatial joins and reproducible programming. These are historical open materials, not a claim about 2026 enrollment.
selection.zh: 选择两套已发布的赫尔辛基课程材料，分别支撑几何、CRS、空间关联与可复现编程；这是历史公开版本，不代表 2026 年招生安排。

courses.institution: University of Helsinki · Department of Geosciences and Geography · Digital Geography Lab
courses.name: Automating GIS processes (AutoGIS)
courses.prerequisites: Basic Python (for example GEOG-329-1); GEOG-G301 Introduction to advanced geoinformatics recommended by the course.
courses.publicMaterials: Lessons, recorded videos and linked exercise instructions are openly readable. This Lab links readings; it does not reproduce or solve their assignments.
courses.registrationAndFees: Reading the public pages requires no registration or payment. University credits, grading, Discord and CSC Noppe access are separate institutional services; Finnish university student eligibility and enrollment apply. No current tuition/credit-fee claim is made.
courses.caveat: The archive contains an unresolved starting_date template. Use its 2024 general information, not that template, for term identification.

courses.name: Geo-Python
courses.publicMaterials: Tutorials, lesson pages, selected videos and exercise instructions are openly readable.
courses.registrationAndFees: Self-study reading is free and needs no registration. Helsinki students sign up under one course code for credit; grading and institutional cloud/chat access are separate. No current 2026 registration or fee availability is asserted.

reading.title: Lesson 2 · Map projections
reading.locator: Handling coordinate reference systems in Geopandas

prediction.en: Which of projected meters, plausible axis swaps and antimeridian coordinates can range validation detect?
prediction.zh: 米制投影、看似合理的经纬度颠倒、跨日期线输入，范围校验分别能发现什么？

action.en: Run U1. Inspect seven rejected inputs and the two accepted but semantically different [24,60] / [60,24] points. The private PROJ exercise converts EPSG:3067 to EPSG:4326 and checks a meter roundtrip.
action.zh: 运行 U1，检查七种拒绝输入与仍可通过范围校验的 [24,60]、[60,24]。私有 PROJ 练习将 EPSG:3067 转为 EPSG:4326，并核对米制往返结果。

perturbation.en: In the workbench, import islands.geojson, add crs to a Feature, and analyze; then remove crs and swap a Point axis order. Relabeling cannot replace reprojection.
perturbation.zh: 在工作台导入 islands.geojson，给 Feature 加 crs 后分析；移除 crs，再交换一个点的轴序。改标签不能代替重投影。

expected.en: CRS members and dateline extents are rejected. A plausible swap is accepted: metadata review remains necessary.
expected.zh: CRS 成员与跨日期线范围被拒绝；合理数值的轴序颠倒仍可能通过，必须核查元数据。

reading.title: Lesson 3 · Point-in-polygon queries
reading.locator: How to check if point is inside a polygon? / shapely geometries

prediction.en: Is [1,3] on a hole edge inside, outside or on the boundary? What changes with covers versus contains?
prediction.zh: [1,3] 位于孔洞边缘，它在内部、外部还是边界？covers 与 contains 会怎样不同？

action.en: Run U2, then probe [-1e-11,3] and [1e-11,3]. Read the separately recorded GEOS counterexample.
action.zh: 运行 U2，再检查 [-1e-11,3] 与 [1e-11,3]，对照单独记录的 GEOS 反例。

perturbation.en: Open the islands workbench. Set probe [1,3], toggle boundary membership, then move to [4,4]. The location label and membership are different concepts.
perturbation.zh: 打开群岛工作台，设点 [1,3] 并切换边界开关，再移到 [4,4]；区分几何位置与是否计入命中。

expected.en: Hole edge is boundary; hole interior is outside. Both 1e-11 probes fall into the Lab tolerance band while GEOS distinguishes their sides.
expected.zh: 孔洞边缘为边界，孔洞内部为外部；两个 1e-11 探针都落入 Lab 容差带，GEOS 则区分内外。

title.zh: 一个 ID 的多个分量

prediction.en: Does the island [2,2]–[3,3] inside another component’s hole belong to the same feature? Is a gap covered by its envelope a member?
prediction.zh: 另一个分量孔洞里的 [2,2]–[3,3] 小岛能否属于同一要素？包围盒内的间隙是否命中？

action.en: Run U3. The original archipelago has three strictly disjoint components and a hole. Contrast overlapping, nested, edge-touching and point-touching components.
action.zh: 运行 U3。原创群岛包含三个严格分离分量和一个孔洞；对比重叠、嵌套、共边与点接触的分量。

perturbation.en: Change the detached component from [8,0]–[10,2] to [5,0]–[7,2]. Analyze and explain the rejection before inspecting the saved validation rows.
perturbation.zh: 将独立分量从 [8,0]–[10,2] 改为 [5,0]–[7,2]，运行并解释拒绝原因，再看保存的校验结果。

expected.en: The island in a hole is accepted. Overlap is rejected. Point-touching is valid in GEOS but intentionally outside this stricter Lab subset.
expected.zh: 孔洞中的小岛可以接受；重叠被拒绝；点接触虽可在 GEOS 中有效，但本 Lab 明确不支持。

title.en: A spatial join is a relation

reading.title: Lesson 3 · Spatial join
reading.locator: Load input data; Join input layers (related official Exercise 3 is linked in the course navigation)

prediction.en: Nine points, two region IDs and four polygon components: how many pairs should remain with and without boundaries?
prediction.zh: 九个点、两个区域 ID、四个面分量：包含与排除边界时各有多少关联对？

action.en: Run U4. Compare all region IDs for east, inspect empty lab_matches for hole, and verify the original input remains unchanged.
action.zh: 运行 U4，检查 east 的全部区域 ID、hole 的空 lab_matches，以及原始输入未被修改。

perturbation.en: Use the islands input in Spatial join, export both boundary settings, and move east from [9,1] to [10.5,1]. Identify precisely which pairs disappear.
perturbation.zh: 在群岛输入上运行空间关联，分别导出两种边界设置；再把 east 从 [9,1] 移到 [10.5,1]，逐项解释消失的关联。

expected.en: Inclusive: 7 pairs / 6 points; strict: 4 pairs / 3 points. Moving east removes both of its pairs.
expected.zh: 包含边界：7 对、6 点；排除边界：4 对、3 点；移动 east 会移除它的两条关联。

title.zh: 证明预过滤保留正确结果

reading.title: Lesson 1 · Convex hull and envelope
reading.locator: Envelope is a bounding rectangle; combine with Lesson 3 spatial join

prediction.en: Which points fool an envelope-only implementation, and which does a first-component implementation miss?
prediction.zh: 仅用包围盒会误收哪些点？仅检查第一分量会漏掉哪些点？

action.en: Run U5. Compare the real full scan with the real prefilter, then inspect two deliberately wrong algorithm controls.
action.zh: 运行 U5，比较真实全扫描与预过滤，再观察两个故意错误的算法对照。

perturbation.en: Move gap to [8.25,1]. It now belongs to archipelago even though it still does not belong to overlap-zone. Recompute rather than relying on the old point ID.
perturbation.zh: 将 gap 移到 [8.25,1]；它现在命中 archipelago，仍不命中 overlap-zone。按新坐标重算，不依赖旧 ID。

expected.en: Scan and prefilter agree. Envelope-only falsely includes hole and gap. First-component-only misses island, east and the east vertex.
expected.zh: 扫描与预过滤一致；仅包围盒误收 hole、gap；仅第一分量漏掉 island、east 及东侧顶点。

reading.title: Lesson 6 · Processing data with pandas II; Debugging your Python code
reading.locator: Parsing dates; supplement with notebooks/L6/debugging.html → Test your code with known outputs

prediction.en: For one longitude degree at 0° and 60° latitude, are degree distance, spherical meters and WGS84 ellipsoidal meters interchangeable?
prediction.zh: 赤道与北纬 60° 的经度一度，角度距离、球面米数和 WGS84 椭球米数是否可互换？

action.en: Run U6. A five-point synthetic minute-spaced track has one isolated spike. The independent PROJ run compares the same two distance pairs against a sphere and WGS84.
action.zh: 运行 U6。五点、逐分钟的合成轨迹含一个孤立跳点；独立 PROJ 运行对同样两对坐标分别进行球面与 WGS84 计算。

perturbation.en: In the original sample, change the speed threshold to 1 km/h and inspect candidates before exporting. A stricter threshold need not remove more isolated points.
perturbation.zh: 在原始示例将速度阈值改为 1 km/h，导出前检查候选；更低阈值不保证孤立跳点候选更多。

expected.en: The original exercise flags two segments and index 2, retaining four points. Spherical and ellipsoidal distances differ; the saved values quantify only these two pairs.
expected.zh: 原创练习标记两条线段与第 2 点，保留四点；球面和椭球距离不同，保存值只量化这两对坐标。
